product.ta-1069.summary: The TA 1069 adapted the TA 1000 for German railway workstations.
product.ta-1069.history: Triumph-Adler built the station for Deutsche Bundesbahn. The TA 1000 variant was integrated into the ITS transport management system. A June 1980 trial in Gremberg documents its use in recording freight wagons.
product.ta-1069.technical.configuration: The station could send data to the central computer. The railway museum documents a screen, light pen, dot-matrix printer and floppy drive.
product.ta-1069.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-1069.technical.limitations: A 32 KiB image attributed to Udo Lechner’s dump is preserved from the SmallCircuits project. The original source and boot remain to be verified.
